id: \bJames: You won't beat us this time.
en: \bJames: You won't beat us this time.

id: \rJessie: Fortune and fame will be ours.
en: \rJessie: Fortune and fame will be ours.

id: \bYou'll never make it to the boss.
en: \bYou'll never make it to the boss.

id: \bGiovanni: At long last, Meloetta. Now awaken Tornadus, Thundurus, Landorus!
en: \bGiovanni: At long last, Meloetta. Now awaken Tornadus, Thundurus, Landorus!
it: \bGiovanni: Finalmente, Meloetta. Ora risveglia Tornadus, Thundurus e Landorus!

id: \bYou're too late if you think you can save Meloetta. I have all of the legendaries under my control. No one will stop me, not even you.
en: \bYou're too late if you think you can save Meloetta. I have all of the legendaries under my control. No one will stop me, not even you.
it: \bSe pensi di poter salvare Meloetta, sei arrivato tardi. Ho tutti i leggendari sotto il mio controllo. Nessuno mi fermerà, nemmeno tu.

id: \bGiovanni: The mission is a failure. We all need to get out of here before the place collapses. Everyone, now!
en: \bGiovanni: The mission is a failure. We all need to get out of here before the place collapses. Everyone, now!
it: \bGiovanni: La missione è fallita. Dobbiamo andarcene tutti prima che questo posto crolli. Tutti, subito!

id: \bMeowth: I can't believe it. The twerp is here. And with the Pokémon we need too.
en: \bMeowth: I can't believe it. The twerp is here. And with the Pokémon we need too.
it: \bMeowth: Non ci posso credere. C'è il moccioso. E ha pure il Pokémon che ci serve.

id: \rJessie: Now's the best chance we have to show off for the boss.
en: \rJessie: Now's the best chance we have to show off for the boss.
it: \rJessie: È la nostra occasione migliore per fare bella figura col capo.

id: \bJames: Then for the boss. Let's get that Pokémon.
en: \bJames: Then for the boss. Let's get that Pokémon.
it: \bJames: Allora per il capo. Prendiamo quel Pokémon.

id: \bJames: The boss managed to get Meloetta. Victory will soon be ours.
en: \bJames: The boss managed to get Meloetta. Victory will soon be ours.
it: \bJames: Il capo è riuscito a prendere Meloetta. Presto la vittoria sarà nostra.
